description: Internet relay (SPEC §10.4). Values derive from groupKey. A blob is nonce(12) || AES-256-GCM(batchKey, nonce, canonical {ops}, aad = mailboxId ASCII). tokenHashHex = SHA-256 of the 64 ASCII characters of the token. 'scenario' runs device A, B, C, A against an empty relay, one sync (pull, then push) each; the k-th POST of the whole scenario uses nonce k (12 bytes: 8 zero bytes, then k as u32 big-endian). 'requests' lists what the client must send, in order, with the relay answers; the k-th mailbox that the relay makes has epoch k as 32 hex digits. 'http' lists single-request checks against a fresh relay.

expiryScenario.description: The same devices. Before step 2 (B) the relay deletes the mailbox, so B makes it again with a new epoch. Step 3 (A) has a stale cursor and vector: it must reset, read from after=0, and send its ops again. The k-th mailbox a relay makes has epoch k as 32 hex digits. Nonces count from 1 again in this run.
